title: Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.01204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer bound

translated_title: 分布偏移下的自回归钻孔建模
translated_abstract: 自回归建模通过学习从历史观测中预测未来状态，在语言和序列任务中取得了显著成功。矿产勘探钻孔为这一范式提供了一个自然但很大程度上未被探索的应用场景：随着钻探的进行，岩性由浅入深依次揭示，使得对更深地层的预测本质上是自回归的。然而，现有的钻孔建模研究主要以空间插值和重建为主，或大多依赖于掩码建模，严格的自回归预测在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。我们提出了DrillBench，一个包含49,671个西澳大利亚州钻孔的基准数据集，用于下一层预测和自回归地层生成，涵盖了从局部预测、空间偏移到跨地质省迁移的梯度化迁移谱系。对经典模型、地统计模型和神经模型的基准测试揭示了一个明显的“迁移边界”。
tldr: 提出了首个面向矿产勘探钻孔的自回归建模基准DrillBench（含49,671个西澳钻孔），通过梯度化迁移场景系统评估经典、地统计与神经模型在下一层预测和自回归地层生成任务上的能力，并揭示了明显的迁移边界。
en_tdlr: Introduces DrillBench, the first autoregressive benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and stratigraphic generation across a graded spectrum of distribution shifts, revealing a clear transfer boundary across classical, geostatistical, and neural models.
